readerCopy.body: A small gesture of kindness can be easier to receive without immediately turning it into a debt that must be repaid. When Venus sextiles Chiron, connection and sensitivity cooperate, allowing appreciation, help, affection, or money to reach an old place of discomfort with less friction. A compliment or favor can remain simple long enough to provide new information. Receiving one good thing plainly can challenge an old expectation more effectively than another argument about deserving it.
